why_agent_cannot: a wallet connection or signature is required
what_human_must_do: Add the LitVM LiteForge testnet to an EVM wallet: chain ID 4441, gas token zkLTC. Take the network address from LitVM's docs . Aura's wallet guide still lists the old Caldera address, "https://liteforge.rpc.caldera.xyz/http", which LitVM has replaced.
Get free test zkLTC from the faucet on the Incentives page. "Distribution happens every six hours per wallet."

Open beta.auralaunch.org/incentives , connect the wallet and link your X account. Warning Many unrelated crypto projects are called Aura. Use only auralaunch.org, beta.auralaunch.org and x.com/auralaunchorg, and never type a seed phrase anywhere.
Do the humanity check. The app says: "Complete the challenge and click on the button below to verify your humanity and ensure eligibility for airdrop rewards." Then claim the daily login bonus.
Make testnet transactions: stake, vote, buy in test sales or deploy a token. Each one is worth 15 points. Do the free social tasks too.

Keep going until you pass 10,000 points with at least one dApp transaction. Aura's own checklist: "Complete your humanity verification and make sure to complete at least one txn. Aim for at least 10k AURA points."
Optional: enter the Token Quest before 30 November 2026 at 14:00 UTC.
costs: The testnet route is free. Gas is paid in faucet zkLTC, and deploying a token costs test coins only: "we've adjusted the token creation fee to 0.01 zkLTC". The task list also has paid items. Boosters raise your points per transaction and cost real money: "Note: Payments are to be made using ONLY ETH on Arbitrum One Mainnet. Boosters activate immediately after purchase."
